name: olla-dft-bench
description: Benchmark harness and published results comparing Olla-DFT with ASE, pymatgen, seekpath and qeschema on Quantum ESPRESSO workflows: same inputs, explicit reference implementations with shared-backend limitations, recomputable statistics, independent verdicts. GPL-3.0. Version 0.2.0 validates complete runs, failed processes, geometry and all QE repetitions; historical results retain their original protocol.
